messages.subject: camtrapR 2.3.0 released on CRAN
parts:
Dear all,
camtrapR 2.3.0 was released on CRAN:
  • New features:
    • Shiny dashboard for data exploration and analysis (surveyDashboard).
    • Temporal filtering of record tables (filterRecordTable).
    • Support for Royle-Nichols models in community occupancy models
    • Enhanced predict function with output types and batch processing.
    • Species richness information from communityModel (JAGS only).
  • Bug fixes:
    • Addresses last camera operation and ProblemX column issues.
    • Corrects errors in prediction and effects plots.
  • Other changes:
    • removed goodness of fit statistics from community model results (pending some checks, will be moved to standalone function in upcoming release)
    • Migrates dependencies, removes rgdal, and updates plot titles.
For details see the NEWS.

As usual install via:
install.packages("camtrapR")

There is also a dev version on GitHub which contains a new function createCovariates (for extracting covariate values from rasters and creating prediction rasters). Install via:
# install.packages("remotes")
# install.packages("R.rsp")
remotes::install_github("jniedballa/camtrapR",ref = "dev", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Best regards,
Jürgen
